newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPG market slow due to industry event.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPG market slow due to industry event.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were mostly steady in late Tuesday trade that had many players sidelined because of an industry event, traders said.

In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane weakened about a quarter cent to between 49.25 cents and 49.50 cents a gallon, the first dip since the market began coming back from last week's fall off.
Spot material in the Midwest held steady, with 49.25 cents and 49.50 cents a gallon in slow trade.
Players said dealings were slow because of golf tournament for traders being sponsored in Houston by Conoco.
The only active liquid in the market was Conway natural gasoline, which jumped about 2.25 cents for the day due to buying interest by major refiners amid few available barrels, according to players.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
